scraper.code:
function listPosts({url,$}) {return {posts:$('article header h2 a').toArray().map(e=>({url:$(e).attr('href'),title:$(e).text(),publishedAt:$(e).closest('article').find('time').attr('datetime')})),next:null};}
function parsePost({url,$}) {const b=$(".markdown").first().clone(); b.find('script,style,nav,.related-posts,.post-navigation,.post-meta,.blog-posts,.upvote-button,form').remove();return {title:$("h1").first().text().trim(),bodyHtml:b.html()||'',author:$('meta[name="author"]').attr('content')||null,publishedAt:$('meta[property="article:published_time"]').attr('content')||$('time[datetime]').first().attr('datetime')||null,tags:[]};}
scraper.notes: 已實抓 /blog 列表頁，透過 article header h2 a 讀取文章連結、time日期；單篇 .markdown 為正文。
